text:
maya: Quick sync — need to finalize rerank endpoint payload shape and scoring normalization for the upcoming launch. Customers want stable scores across model variants + clear truncation rules. Can we lock MVP scope by EOD?

chris: Eng constraints: main limits are request size and p95 latency. top_k directly impacts compute (we score each candidate). Suggest default top_k=100, hard max 1000.

devin: ML note: normalization options matter. Two viable paths: softmax over candidates (model-side) OR post-hoc calibration (Platt scaling / isotonic) using a calibration set. Softmax unstable when candidate set changes. Recommend we return raw_scores + normalized_scores (0-1) using post-hoc scaler for MVP.

sana: Data ops: Truncation policy needs to be deterministic. If query+candidate > context, prefer truncating candidate tail, keep query intact. Expose truncation_strategy enum: ["truncate_candidate_tail","truncate_candidate_head","reject"]. Also include a per-request seed to guarantee deterministic tie-breaking.

eve: UX: Response should be concise by default but include full metadata when requested. Propose response modes: compact (id+rank+normalized_score) and full (adds raw_score, tokens_used, reason_codes).

maya: Customer-driven asks to prioritize: 1) documented stable sorting & deterministic tie-break, 2) per-request seed and score_version, 3) pagination for large candidate sets, 4) regression tests (NDCG/MRR) & canary.

chris: Scope negotiation — MVP will implement: top_k param, normalized_scores (post-hoc), deterministic seed, truncation_strategy, compact/full response modes, and score_version field. Out of scope for MVP: streaming partial ranks, auto-calibration pipeline, and model-side softmax as default. Those are 2.0 items.

devin: For evals we'll provide NDCG@k, MRR, and a fixed regression promptset. Include a 'quality_regression' alert that fires if NDCG drops > 2% vs baseline.

sana: Also add 'score_version' string in response and 'model_variant' metadata so consumers can validate downstream metrics stability.

chris: Perf targets for launch: p95 latency for 100 candidates < 120ms on Dedicated, tail degradation graceful. Cost targets: target label for product to fill (placeholder). We should also document how top_k affects billing.

maya: Acceptance checklist (MVP):
- API supports top_k (default 100, max 1000)
- truncation_strategy param and documented deterministic truncation rules
- response includes id, rank, raw_score, normalized_score, score_version, model_variant
- deterministic ordering via seed param
- compact vs full response modes
- automated NDCG/MRR regression tests in CI and console alerts

chris: Implementation notes: we'll score candidates in streaming batches to limit memory, but return ranked array only when scoring complete for deterministic ranks. That means no streaming of partial ranks in MVP.

maya: Example request/response (MVP shape):
```json
{
  "request": {
    "query": "best restaurants near me",
    "candidates": ["id:123","id:234", "id:345", "..."],
    "top_k": 50,
    "truncation_strategy": "truncate_candidate_tail",
    "seed": 42,
    "response_mode": "compact"
  }
}

// response
{
  "results": [
    {"id":"234","rank":1,"normalized_score":0.95,"raw_score":3.24},
    {"id":"123","rank":2,"normalized_score":0.88,"raw_score":2.71}
  ],
  "score_version": "v1.0.0",
  "model_variant": "rerank-open-1.2"
}
```

devin: Also suggest we include a "calibration_metadata" block in full responses for debug: scaler_type + calibration_dataset_id + coverage. Out of scope for compact.

maya: I'll draft the spec doc and add the acceptance checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/specs/rerank/payload-and-calibration (placeholder). Please drop a +1, :thumbsup:, or post objections. If no blocking concerns, I'll freeze MVP scope at EOD.

chris: +1

devin: +1

sana: +1

eve: +1 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy status: staging build #4822 passed tests for the rerank service (smoke).

maya: Thanks all — will circulate final spec and owners for the checklist tomorrow morning.
